headline: Ramayana is forecast to reach 2.42M tickets today and Jailer 2 about 29.7K, both estimates with wide ranges.
bullets: Ramayana has sold 216K so far today, and its day total is estimated at 2.42M (range 2.02M to 2.79M), 77% vs yesterday.
Its busiest hour ahead is expected at 10–11 PM, around 320K (range 185K to 480K), with 11 AM–12 PM at about 139K.
Jailer 2 has sold 4.3K so far, with its day total estimated at 29.7K (range 24.7K to 34.1K), which is -8% vs yesterday.
Tomorrow, Tuesday, is an ordinary weekday with no holiday, so Ramayana could reach 2.69M (range 1.66M to 3.34M) and Jailer 2 about 33K (range 20.3K to 40.9K).
watch: Neither film has review, rating or word-of-mouth signals switched on, so these figures are based on history alone and are not adjusted for them.
Show and screen counts are not included, so a change in them could move the forecast, especially for tomorrow's wide range.
